description: Canada Goose reported a 60% reduction in planning cycle time and a 4% improvement in revenue forecast accuracy after implementing an AI scenario planning system.

AI-powered scenario planning reduced planning cycle time by 60% and improved revenue forecast accuracy by 4% at Canada Goose.
